inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL-compatible logistics update loads non-terminal scans with INSERT ... SELECT and ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, using IF and VALUES to replace every state field only when the incoming sequence is newer; delivered scans are removed afterward with a joined DELETE.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored shipment-state refresh. A stale scan must leave the existing state untouched, newer scans update all state fields, unseen shipments are inserted, and a delivered scan removes an existing shipment through a separate joined DELETE. The source schema, identifiers, values, and logistics labels are new.

fixture_notes: Shipment 501 receives an older scan and must retain its existing state; shipment 502 receives a newer scan and updates every state column; shipment 504 is inserted; shipment 503 is removed because its incoming scan is delivered.
determinism_notes: Each shipment has one source scan and one primary-key state row, sequence numbers are fixed, and every result is ordered by shipment ID. There are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipment_scans (scan_id INT PRIMARY KEY, shipment_id INT NOT NULL, scan_seq INT NOT NULL, location_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, scan_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, recorded_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE shipment_state (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, scan_seq INT NOT NULL, location_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, scan_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, recorded_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO shipment_state (shipment_id, scan_seq, location_code, scan_state, recorded_label) SELECT shipment_id, scan_seq, location_code, scan_state, recorded_label FROM shipment_scans WHERE scan_state <> 'delivered' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scan_seq = IF(VALUES(scan_seq) > shipment_state.scan_seq, VALUES(scan_seq), shipment_state.scan_seq), location_code = IF(VALUES(scan_seq) > shipment_state.scan_seq, VALUES(location_code), shipment_state.location_code), scan_state = IF(VALUES(scan_seq) > shipment_state.scan_seq, VALUES(scan_state), shipment_state.scan_state), recorded_label = IF(VALUES(scan_seq) > shipment_state.scan_seq, VALUES(recorded_label), shipment_state.recorded_label)
DELETE shipment_state FROM shipment_state JOIN shipment_scans ON shipment_scans.shipment_id = shipment_state.shipment_id WHERE shipment_scans.scan_state = 'delivered'
SELECT shipment_id, scan_seq, location_code, scan_state, recorded_label FROM shipment_state ORDER BY shipment_id
